read.thesis: Toyota H1 operating income JPY 2.2 trillion with full-year guidance raised JPY 500 billion to JPY 3.9 trillion, mostly FX and tariff relief; China volumes weak and no capacity cuts, while capex plan rises to JPY 22 trillion over five years.

utilisation.quote: we will fully utilize our existing capabilities while also establishing new plants in necessary regions to increase our production capacity

capex.peers_comment: Chinese manufacturers are now active in Asia and Europe and Latin America.
capex.quote: We plan to allocate JPY 22 trillion to capital expenditures and R&D and a dedicated portion for flexible growth investments

triggers.label: FY operating income guidance raised JPY 500bn
triggers.quote: We have revised our full-year operating income forecast upward by JPY 500 billion from our previous forecast to JPY 3,900,000,000,000.

triggers.label: China volumes weak, market share held
triggers.quote: the market has been downsizing year-on-year. Especially the conventional ICE vehicles has seen a significant drop

triggers.label: Capex and R&D plan JPY 22tn over five years
triggers.quote: We plan to allocate JPY 22 trillion to capital expenditures and R&D and a dedicated portion for flexible growth investments

triggers.label: North America back to profit JPY 166.1bn
triggers.quote: North America returned to profitability largely due to price revisions and the reduced impact of U.S. tariffs.

guidance.quote: We have revised our full-year operating income forecast upward by JPY 500 billion from our previous forecast
increased our share repurchase authorization by JPY 300 billion, bringing the total amount of this fiscal year up to JPY 1,300,000,000,000.
the interim dividend is set at JPY 50 per share
Looking toward 2030, we will build a business structure that places battery electric vehicles on top of a robust foundation of 10 million vehicles

red_flags.label: Admitted cost reduction still has room; tariff and Middle East impacts not defeated
red_flags.quote: There are lots of places where we can further correct and amend.

red_flags.label: China sales volume under pressure
red_flags.quote: as a sales network, we are still struggling, and we are in a tough situation.

evasions.topic: North America loss and RAV4 launch
evasions.quote: there's some things that we'll have to wait for the appropriate timing.
I'm sorry, for my end, I think that as amount of profit value or as a business, it sounds a little small scale.
